Then restart Dolphin. Under Wii Remote 1 → Emulated, a DSUClient device appears in the device dropdown.
Under Motion Input, map all Accelerometer and Gyroscope entries name-to-name, and map Recenter (gyro pointing drifts — press it in-game to summon the pointer).

Press-a-button detection in Android emulators only sees Android input devices, so it never detects DSU inputs. Map them manually instead — pick from the DSU device\'s input list or type them in the expression field.
SL, SR and C have no DSU equivalent and aren\'t streamed. Exception: a solo sideways Joy-Con, where SL/SR act as its shoulder buttons.
If the Virtual Gamepad is also on, detection grabs your press from it instead — turn it off while mapping DSU inputs.
